candidates.name: Rhabdomyolysis
support_spans: Serum creatinine increased to 760.24 µmol/L (8.61 mg/dL)
Creatine kinase level: 10,698 U/L
Urinalysis showed myoglobinuria
Urine sediment showed acute tubular necrosis with muddy brown casts
candidates.why: The patient's elevated creatine kinase level, myoglobinuria, and acute tubular necrosis with muddy brown casts are indicative of rhabdomyolysis.

candidates.name: Acute Kidney Injury
support_spans: weeks of worsening renal function
Serum creatinine increased to 760.24 µmol/L (8.61 mg/dL)
oliguria
candidates.why: The patient's worsening renal function, elevated serum creatinine, and oliguria suggest acute kidney injury.

candidates.name: Drug-induced Rhabdomyolysis
support_spans: Several weeks after starting a new medication, he experienced decreased appetite, weakness, and fatigue
Creatine kinase level: 10,698 U/L
Urinalysis showed myoglobinuria
candidates.why: The temporal relationship between the initiation of a new medication and the onset of symptoms, combined with laboratory evidence of rhabdomyolysis, suggests drug-induced rhabdomyolysis.
